description: Enrichment orders on the work-order queue, run by the box. action start, with area (one of the Index's key ids, e.g. credit-by-exam), schools (a list, each a UNITID or a school's name; a name is taken only when it matches one school) and dry_run (default false), writes the order WO-V<MMDD>-<NN>_ENRICHMENT.md to the work-orders folder and runs it in the background, one order at a time. For each school on its own it runs, in order: discover and rekey (the Index's keys for the area's pages; rekey backs up institutions.json), Gather with --recapture-what-we-hold, Harvest, the area's check and post, and the Serve load for the school and area. A step that fails ends that school; the others still run. A dry run writes nothing but the steps' records: rekey and check without apply, Gather and Harvest skipped, Serve's plan only. action status, with number, answers the order's state, each school's steps, the report and, once it ends, the Normandy notice, ready to send (nothing is published or sent). action list (the default) answers the enrichment orders, newest first, and the areas the phrase table holds. Example: 'enrich Temple and Arizona, credit by exam' is start with schools ["Temple University", "University of Arizona"] and area credit-by-exam.

area.description: start: the area, one of the Index's key ids

dry_run.description: start: true writes nothing but the steps' records

schools.description: start: each school, by UNITID or name

started_by.description: start: who started it, as the report names them

name: enrichment_run
title: Enrichment Run
